purpose: Validate paradigm-distance rubric and scout-frontier criteria for code-intelligence domain. 6 expected paradigm-distinct findings + 6 negative controls.
test_query: code intelligence engines paradigm-distinct from example-org/code-graph

negative_controls.name: tirth8205/code-review-graph
negative_controls._notes: Graph of symbols + traversal queries + static-with-incremental indexing — same paradigm as code-graph, different implementation.

negative_controls.name: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
negative_controls._notes: Symbol graph traversed at query time; same four axes as the incumbent.

negative_controls.name: aovestdipaperino/tokensave
negative_controls._notes: Same-paradigm peer; better-implemented graph + traversal, no axis shift.

negative_controls.name: optave/ops-codegraph-tool
negative_controls._notes: Same four axes as code-graph; feature differences are /scout territory, not paradigm distance.

instrument_validation.tpr: All 6 expected recompute to distance >= 1 from their per-axis values (TPR = 1.0).
instrument_validation.fpr: All 6 negative controls carry per-axis values identical to the incumbent and recompute to distance 0 (FPR = 0).
instrument_validation.result: Instrument valid — verified by scripts/score_rubric.py, which recomputes distance from axes for BOTH the expected set and the controls.
instrument_validation.validated: 2026-04-26; control axes added 2026-05-31 so the scorer measures FPR instead of trusting the declared 0.
